turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Hey, since we've been chatting so openly, I was wondering if you could share a bit about your financial situation too? It feels like we're getting to know each other pretty well.

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I appreciate your openness, but I prefer to keep my financial details private for now. Let's enjoy getting to know each other through our interests and experiences!

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Absolutely, that makes sense! How about this – we share one interesting experience each related to finance or money? It can be a story or a lesson learned without diving into specifics. What do you think?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: That sounds like a fun idea! One thing I've learned is the importance of planning ahead for retirement. It's all about balance and making sure your savings can last. Your turn!

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Great insight! I once learned the value of emergency funds the hard way when my car broke down. Turns out, having that cushion really saves a lot of stress. [WALK_AWAY]
